purpose: Offline, synthetic regression/evaluation fixtures for email parsing and threat-analysis policy.
provenance_policy: Authored for this repository; no real mailbox samples, external threat-feed samples, or provider-derived labels.
network_policy: No network access is needed or permitted for fixture parsing. Disable or stub external validators, reputation and enrichment when running analysis tests. Do not visit URL-like strings.

taxonomy.label: benign_legitimate
taxonomy.definition: Routine expected business communication with no persuasive malicious request.

taxonomy.label: phishing
taxonomy.definition: Impersonation or deceptive request intended to induce an unsafe action; not necessarily credential capture.

taxonomy.label: credential_harvesting
taxonomy.definition: Explicit attempt to collect passwords, one-time codes, or account authentication data.

taxonomy.label: bec_payment_change
taxonomy.definition: Business email compromise pattern requesting a payment or beneficiary change.

taxonomy.label: suspicious_inconclusive
taxonomy.definition: Anomaly warrants review, but the available fixture evidence does not establish malicious intent.

taxonomy.label: malformed_email
taxonomy.definition: Deliberately malformed RFC 5322-like input for parser robustness; not a threat verdict.

taxonomy.label: authentication_edge_case
taxonomy.definition: A message whose content label is independent of untrusted, message-supplied authentication claims.

fixtures.label: benign_legitimate
fixtures.provenance: Authored synthetic fixture; fictional sender and recipient under example.invalid.
fixtures.sanitization: No personal data, secrets, active domains, public IPs, or attachments.
evidence: Routine meeting coordination
No credential, payment, or link request
fixtures.rationale: Ordinary scheduling message with no suspicious action request.

fixtures.label: benign_legitimate
fixtures.provenance: Authored synthetic fixture; fictional sender and recipient under example.invalid.
fixtures.sanitization: No personal data, secrets, active domains, public IPs, or attachments.
evidence: Compliance notice discusses fraud prevention
Mentions password and identity verification in a warning not to disclose them
No external link or urgent account action
fixtures.rationale: Negative hard case: risky vocabulary appears in a protective disclaimer, not a request to act.
expected_parser_notes: keyword-only detection must not determine label

fixtures.label: phishing
fixtures.provenance: Authored synthetic fixture; fictional brand and domains under example.invalid.
fixtures.sanitization: URL host ends in .invalid and is inert; no personal data, secrets, public IPs, or attachments.
evidence: Unverified sender claims to represent a fictional service
Threatens account restriction to force immediate action
Contains a link to a non-matching fictional host
fixtures.rationale: Multiple contextual signals indicate impersonation and coercive link use; label is not based on one keyword or authentication result.
expected_parser_notes: do not fetch or resolve the URL

fixtures.label: credential_harvesting
fixtures.provenance: Authored synthetic fixture; fictional sender, organization and host under example.invalid.
fixtures.sanitization: URL host ends in .invalid and is inert; no real credentials, personal data, public IPs, or attachments.
evidence: Direct request for account password and one-time code
Threatens suspension unless user submits authentication data
Credential form URL uses a fictional unrelated host
fixtures.rationale: Explicit collection of authentication secrets is the defining behavior.

fixtures.label: bec_payment_change
fixtures.provenance: Authored synthetic fixture; fictional employee identities and organization under example.invalid.
fixtures.sanitization: No real bank details, account numbers, personal data, credentials, URLs, or attachments.
evidence: Sender requests urgent change to an invoice beneficiary
Asks recipient to bypass normal callback verification
Request is inconsistent with established payment controls described in message
fixtures.rationale: Payment redirection plus an explicit control-bypass request is a synthetic BEC pattern.
expected_parser_notes: sender display name alone is not the label basis

fixtures.label: suspicious_inconclusive
fixtures.provenance: Authored synthetic fixture; fictional sender and recipient under example.invalid.
fixtures.sanitization: No personal data, secrets, active domains, public IPs, or attachments.
evidence: Reply-To domain differs from From domain
Body asks for a document review but provides no link, credential request, payment change, or verifiable context
fixtures.rationale: The identity mismatch merits analyst review, but the message alone does not establish fraud.
expected_parser_notes: identity mismatch should remain evidence, not proof of maliciousness

fixtures.label: malformed_email
fixtures.provenance: Authored synthetic malformed input for parser robustness.
fixtures.sanitization: Contains only fictional text; no addresses, secrets, URLs, IPs, or attachments.
evidence: Invalid header field name
Header/body separator and field structure are intentionally malformed
fixtures.rationale: This is a parser robustness case, not a maliciousness label; parsers may recover some fields or report an explicit parse status.
expected_parser_notes: preserve explicit parse status and available raw evidence

fixtures.label: authentication_edge_case
fixtures.provenance: Authored synthetic fixture; fictional sender and recipient under example.invalid.
fixtures.sanitization: No personal data, secrets, active domains, public IPs, or attachments.
evidence: Routine project status body with no risky action request
Authentication-Results header claims SPF, DKIM and DMARC pass
Header is supplied inside the email and is not trusted validation evidence
fixtures.rationale: Content label is benign; the claimed authentication outcomes must remain untrusted unless independently validated with trusted transport context.
expected_parser_notes: reported authentication claims distinct from validator statuses
do not infer benignness solely from PASS claims
